About this propertyPrivate pool and golf views: BRG GOLF CLUB - Danang Private Pool Villa 3 Bedrooms #1 is a spacious villa in Hòa Hải, Da Nang, situated next to BRG Golf Club and Montgomery Links. It has a private pool with direct views over the BRG Golf Course, a sizable balcony, sun terrace and garden.

Living areas and kitchens: The villa’s living room includes a sofa, TV and a fireplace. There are two fully equipped kitchens with an oven, stovetop, refrigerator, microwave, toaster, coffee machine, electric kettle and kitchenware. A washing machine is available and the property provides laundry and drying service for loads under 3 kg.

Bedrooms and bathrooms: Accommodation comprises three bedrooms and three bathrooms. The bedrooms feature one Super King bed (2.2 x 2 m) and two Queen beds (1.6 x 2 m); a sofa bed is also provided. Bathrooms include showers and a bidet.

Dining, service and location: An on-site restaurant serves dinner and breakfasts are offered in continental, American and Asian styles with warm dishes, pastries and fruit. Guests receive travel guides, a JBL Bluetooth speaker and drinking water; free parking is available on site and free afternoon tea is provided for stays of three nights. The villa is around 400 metres from the beach, with Non Nuoc nearby, and Da Nang International Airport is about 11 km away. Guests particularly praise the staff and service support.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

hostInfo.name: Anh Pham
hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
EXPLORE THE POINT VILLA 
❤This is where you can watch golfers practice and is right next to two of the world's leading golf courses in Da Nang: BRG Golf Club and Montgomery Links
❤This is where you can gaze out at the lush green lawns and breathe in the fresh air
❤It is the ideal destination for families and friends on the vacation you've been waiting for. It's just 400m from the beach, making it convenient for walking along the coast
★FREE AIRPORT PICK-UP SERVICE for vehicles from 7 to 16 seats, applicable for stays of 5 nights or more
★FREE AFTERNOON TEA applicable for stays of 3 nights
★Experience a luxurious private pool with views of the BRG Golf Course
Safe children's play Area★FREE within the spacious grounds
Outdoor BBQ Grill★FREE, ready for your party
FREE villa cleaning★every day, upon request
★24/7 check-in, convenient all day long
★24/7 security team ensures safety at the resort
★FREE drinking water
★FREE JBL Bluetooth speaker for enjoying music
★FREE parking right in front of the Villa
✧ Accommodation: Relish the expansive, breezy, and serene ambiance of the villa, complete with a sizable balcony. The villa offers a cool breeze and the freshness of nature from every corner, ideal for unwinding and revitalizing
✧ Cooking: The spacious living room opens up to two contemporary, fully-equipped kitchens that include a microwave, toaster, and oven, providing the perfect setting for outdoor BBQ gatherings
✧ Luxurious sleep: with a Super King (2.2 x 2m) bed, 2 Queen size beds (1.6 x 2m), ensuring a peaceful night amidst the fresh air of nature
✧ Luxurious and clean bathrooms: Enjoy the privacy of 3 well-appointed bathrooms, each furnished with all the essential amenities to ensure your comfort and convenience
We offer complimentary travel guides to renowned tourist attractions and eateries in Da Nang, Hoi An, curated from local insights. For further details, please reach out to us!
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
"As your host, I’m passionate about creating experiences that go beyond just a place to stay. It’s a joy for me to guide guests through the best this neighborhood has to offer, from hidden spots to must-see attractions. I truly believe this area adds something special to the experience, making each stay memorable. I chose this neighborhood because it offers a unique combination of peacefulness, natural beauty, and a sense of refined luxury. Nestled within the renowned BRG Golf Course, this area provides a serene escape that feels worlds away from the hustle and bustle, yet it’s close to everything you need for a comfortable and enriching stay – surrounded by nature, beautiful landscapes and the quiet ambiance creates a feeling of true relaxation, letting you enjoy the sounds of nature and the fresh, open air. It’s a perfect spot for those looking to unwind and reconnect with themselves."

“Beyond the tranquility, you'll find yourself perfectly situated to explore the surrounding luxury resorts and fine dining establishments such as Sheraton Grand Danang, Ocean Estate, Ocean Resort, and Fusion. The villa is also just a 10-15 minute walk from a private beach & 10-15 minutes by car from the famous & bustling An Thuong neighborhood in Da Nang. Additionally, there is a delightful vegetarian restaurant and tea house located near the beach - Maha Mangala Restaurant, offering you the ultimate blend of convenience and exclusivity”

Golf Lovers' Paradise: Just steps away from one of Da Nang’s finest golf courses. For golf enthusiasts, this is a dream come true. Staying right by the renowned BRG Golf Course gives guests the unique opportunity to start their day with a round of golf in one of Asia’s top-rated courses, all while enjoying the comfort of a luxurious home just minutes away. Additionally, pristine sandy beaches are just a short stroll away.
➺Don’t hesitate to reach out with any questions !
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
OTHER POINTS OF INTEREST
The Point Villa is conveniently located near several famous attractions:
* 3 minutes to Ngu Hanh Son mountain.
* 3 minutes to Montgomerie Links Vietnam Golf Club.
* 5 minutes to My Khe Beach and the lively An Thuong tourist area.
* 5 minutes to Crowne Plaza Da Nang Casino.
* 7 minutes to Asia Park.
* 13-minute drive to Da Nang City Center and the night market.
* 18 minutes to Da Nang International Airport.
* 20 minutes to Son Tra Peninsula and Linh Ung Pagoda.
* 25 minutes to Hoi An Ancient Town.

➽ Vietnamese Cuisine
1. Luk Lak Da Nang: Situated along the Han River, this restaurant presents authentic Vietnamese flavors with an innovative twist.
2. Am Thuc Tran: Renowned for its traditional Vietnamese fare, including nem chua and vermicelli specialties.
3. Madame Lan Restaurant: Nestled on the Han River's edge, it provides a cozy ambiance and a menu abundant with Vietnamese culinary delights.

✈︎ 𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐃𝐨 𝐢𝐧 𝐇𝐨𝐢 𝐀𝐧:

2. ** 𝐓𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐚 𝐋𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧 𝐁𝐨𝐚𝐭 𝐑𝐢𝐝𝐞:Experience the beauty of Hoi An at night by taking a lantern-lit boat ride along the Thu Bon River, especially during the monthly Lantern Festival.
